profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Playwire
profile.summary:
I am very diligent and attentive to detail with a very outgoing, positive attitude. I like to say I am a very talented and ambitious Computer Programmer specializing in Ruby on Rails Web Development, CSS, JQuery, CoffeScript, JavaScript. And some background in PosgreSQL, SQL, Java. In addition to testing frameworks including but not limited to Cucumber, RSpec.

I like to make sure a project I am working on is done right the first time no matter how tedious the task may seem, a little obsessive sometimes but it’s what makes me proud of my work. I'm a fast learner and dedicated hand who understands how to build and maintain professional relationships. I’m a bit of a coach sometimes and enjoy learning and teaching to others the knowledge that has been passed down to me.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Develop, maintain and upgrade a Ruby on Rails application designed to provide system software engineers a user interface/repository to manage their hardware and software components.

• Use a variety of languages and software engineering techniques including but not limited to JavaScript, JQuery, and CSS, in addition to open source Ruby gems (or libraries) to facilitate design and development when upgrading or implementing new features.

• Provide direct support to Operations Engineers, troubleshooting software and data related non-conformances, determining root causes, permanent solutions and workarounds when applicable.
